FN-T7YH91-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 455
Committee: Urban and Rural Development Sponsor: Representative David Standridge
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/10/2023
House Bill 455 as introduced would create the Rural and Community Fire Protection
Development and Improvement Grant Program, funded by the Rural and Community Fire
Protection Development and Improvement Fund created by this bill in the State Treasury, to
fund grants to certain volunteer fire departments to address certain goals provided in this bill.
This bill would also increase the obligations of the State Forestry Commission by an
undetermined amount to administer the grant program and a statewide grant training program,
established by this bill, which would be offset, in whole or in part, by the retention of 5% of the
annual appropriations to the fund, as provided by this bill.
